---
title: Aligning typebars by eye
summary: Capital H and lowercase n tell the story.
topic: alignment
---

Type a row of capital H and lowercase n alternately across a clean sheet. Letters that sit high have a bent typebar near the segment, and letters that lean were struck together at some point in the past. Use two pairs of smooth jawed pliers, one to hold and one to bend, and move the bar less than seems reasonable. Check the row again after every single correction.
